title: Curious Cometary Knots in the Helix Nebula
explanation: What causes unusual knots of gas and dust in planetary nebulas?  Seen also in the Ring Nebula, the Dumbbell Nebula and NGC 2392, the knots' existence was not initially predicted, and their origins are still not well understood.  Pictured here is a fascinating image of part of the Helix Nebula by the James Webb Space Telescope showing tremendous detail in infrared light.
